name: Announcement Bar
summary: Controlled compact announcement surface with exclusive static, canonical Countdown, or canonical Carousel rotation content and optional target-owned dismissal.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Controlled compact surface, omitted when visible is false.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Intrinsic content row that wraps without hiding, scaling, or clipping content.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Static-mode message with an optional canonical Link.

anatomy.name: countdown
anatomy.description: Countdown-mode slot containing canonical Countdown in its inline presentation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Focusable horizontal scroll-snap viewport for real message slides.

anatomy.name: slide
anatomy.description: Ordered real message group; rotation never clones slides.

anatomy.name: controls
anatomy.description: Rotating-mode previous, counter, next and conditional pause/play controls.

anatomy.name: counter
anatomy.description: Visible localized current/total position such as 2/3.

anatomy.name: rotationControl
anatomy.description: Canonical pause/play Icon Button rendered only while autoplay is enabled.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Visually hidden localized position status updated after selection changes.

anatomy.name: dismiss
anatomy.description: Canonical Close Button that emits a dismiss request without owning removal or persistence.

variants.name: static
variants.description: One stable message and optional canonical Link.

variants.name: countdown
variants.description: Canonical inline Countdown composition; rotating content is absent.

variants.name: rotating
variants.description: Canonical Carousel rotation composition; static and countdown content are absent.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Compact intrinsic size that may wrap into additional rows from its container.

states.name: default
states.description: Visible controlled surface with autoplay off by default.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: Orthogonal controlled Close Button is present in any content mode.

states.name: currentMessage
states.description: Exactly one real rotating message is current.

states.name: autoplayPlaying
states.description: Opt-in rotation is advancing while no pause condition applies.

states.name: autoplayPaused
states.description: Rotation remains durably or temporarily paused.

states.name: userPaused
states.description: Focus or manual selection created a durable pause that requires explicit Play.

states.name: reducedMotion
states.description: Automatic rotation and smooth scrolling are suppressed.

states.name: closed
states.description: Target-controlled closed state is omitted or natively hidden and non-interactive.

behavior.name: exclusiveContentMode
behavior.description: Exactly one static, countdown, or rotating content model is rendered; countdown and rotation never coexist.

behavior.name: staticSemantics
behavior.description: Page-load promotional content has no alert, status, or live-region role by default and uses a native Link only for navigation.

behavior.name: countdownComposition
behavior.description: Countdown mode delegates deadline, units, cadence, expiry and events to canonical Countdown and preserves every selected unit while wrapping intrinsically.

behavior.name: rotatingSelection
behavior.description: Previous, next and supplementary direct touch scrolling wrap through real slides, synchronize current state and visible current/total position, and never intercept root-wide arrow keys.

behavior.name: autoplayLifecycle
behavior.description: Autoplay is opt-in, defaults off, uses a six-second default, pauses for hover, focus and hidden-document conditions, is suppressed by reduced motion, and never restarts implicitly after user interaction.

behavior.name: dismissRequest
behavior.description: Canonical Close Button requests dismissal; the target controls visible state, eligibility, persistence, reappearance and focus after removal.

behavior.name: controlledOwnership
behavior.description: The neutral implementation projects target state and emits requests; targets own campaign scheduling, targeting, persistence, analytics and navigation.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Exclusive static, countdown, or rotating content model.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible region name; required by composition when mode is rotating and optional when another mode is intentionally exposed as a region.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Required static-mode message with an optional canonical Link.

properties.name: countdown
properties.description: Required countdown-mode canonical Countdown configured with inline presentation.

properties.name: messages
properties.description: Required rotating-mode ordered collection of at least two concise message slides.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Target-controlled presence; false omits or natively hides the whole surface.

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description: Shows a canonical Close Button in any mode without adding persistence or reappearance policy.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name for the conditional Close Button.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.description: Opt-in timed rotation used only in rotating mode; a visible pause/play control is then required.

properties.name: autoplayInterval
properties.description: Rotation interval in milliseconds, read only when rotating autoplay is enabled.

properties.name: previousLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name for the previous-message Icon Button.

properties.name: nextLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name for the next-message Icon Button.

properties.name: pauseLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name while the rotation control pauses autoplay.

properties.name: playLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name while the rotation control resumes autoplay.

properties.name: counterTemplate
properties.description: Localized visible position template containing {current} and {total}, for example {current}/{total}.

properties.name: statusTemplate
properties.description: Localized assistive position template containing {current} and {total}.

accessibility: Keep static page-load content neutral; do not add alert or live-region semantics by default.
Require a useful accessible region name for rotating content and expose each real message as an ordered slide group.
Provide native previous, next, conditional pause/play and dismiss buttons with localized names.
Pause opt-in autoplay for focus, hover and hidden documents, suppress it under reduced motion, and require explicit Play after user interaction.
Preserve direct touch scrolling and focused track keyboard scrolling without intercepting Arrow keys on the root.
Keep countdown units and rotating messages readable under narrow containers, localization, RTL, zoom, forced colors and reduced motion.
Do not place critical checkout, legal or safety information only in an automatically rotating promotional surface.

web.notes: Canonical CSS, Countdown composition and shared Carousel rotation runtime implement all three controlled modes without target persistence.

shopify.notes: The existing Theme section maps merchant rich text to the canonical static mode. Countdown, rotation and controlled dismissal remain explicit target maturity work rather than copied behavior.
